messages:
maria_sales: FYI Zephyr wants to run a 2-week POC. Requirements: billing project, $5k spend cap, 14-day trial credits, dedicated GPU for sustained load, and VPC peering. Can we stand this up quickly?

 tom_se: Yes. Standard flow: create billing org + project, attach spendshield, grant trial credits, issue scoped API keys. Dedicated and VPC need infra sign-off.

 anika_finops: On credits/spend: we can grant 14 days of promo credits (suggest $2k). We can also attach a hard spendshield at $5k for the project so requests stop at the cap. Important: promo credits are consumed before spendshield kicks in. No automatic billing beyond spendshield. Manual approval required for credits >$1k.

 maria_sales: Sales wants us to cover $2k in credits and set the spendshield at $5k. Customer won't provide a payment method for the trial. Is that OK?

 anika_finops: That's fine. I need legal company name + billing contact email to set up the billing org. I'll queue the credit grant for manual approval.

 jason_infra: For Dedicated: please provide expected RPS, model family (approx token/sec), and preferred region. For VPC peering we need a short network diagram and target CIDR for peering. We can spin up a temporary "dedicated-burst" pool for 2 weeks if capacity available.

 maria_sales: I'll ask Zephyr for network CIDR and contact. They estimate 60 req/s, model family similar to gpt-medium, about 4k tokens/sec aggregate, prefer eu-west-1. They'd like peering but can start without it.

 liam_se: Sharing an ephemeral key snippet they can use (14d TTL):

```
# create ephemeral key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/ephemeral \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_SVC_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"project_id":"proj-zephyr-poc","ttl_seconds":1209600,"scopes":["inference:generate"],"notes":"Zephyr POC 14d"}'\
\n# basic usage example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"t5-large","input":"Hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

 liam_se: Recommend rotating keys mid-POC and limiting scopes (no billing or admin scopes). If they need multiple dev keys we can issue project-scoped keys per engineer.

 sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://forms.redwood.ai/sec-ssq-zephyr. VPC requests require SOC/infra checklist and a network diagram.

 jason_infra: Created infra ticket infra/2468: "Zephyr POC - dedicated burst + optional VPC peering" assigned to jason_infra. ETA: 72h for capacity check and peering feasibility.

 anika_finops: I submitted finance ticket finance/8021 to approve $2000 promo credits + spendshield $5000. Pending manager approval.

 maria_sales: Action items: (1) I'll send legal name + billing contact (2) Zephyr to fill sec questionnaire if they want peering (3) Jason to confirm dedicated availability (4) Anika to approve credits. Will update Zephyr and propose Monday kickoff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

 provision-bot: finance/8021: "Zephyr promo credits $2000 + spendshield $5000" queued for approval — approver: anika_finops.
